title: Chapter 253 Gambling
content:
Chapter 253 Gambling

With the statements of Xiaoyaozi and Master Ban, the major events in the world have begun to shift towards the direction of Yuguo, the situation has changed dramatically, and the momentum is magnificent.

It is said that there are hundreds of schools of thought, but that is just a description, and there are only a dozen or so schools that can really be counted.

Among these more than ten families, the Yinyang family and the famous family have already taken refuge in the family early, and now the Mohist family and the Dan Taoist family have also taken refuge in the family, plus the associated doctors, and half of the forces of the vertical and horizontal family represented by Wei Zhuang. Gathered under the command of Yuguo.

What is left now is not the forces that have taken refuge in the imperial kingdom. Count carefully, only Confucianism, Taoism Tianzong, miscellaneous schools, novelists, strategists Gai Nie faction, and the current peasant family.

As for the remaining legalists and military strategists, let’s not talk about them, there are some of them in almost every country. These two families do not have any nominal leaders, and their thoughts and ideas are also different, so there is no question of who to rely on.

The two people in front of him represented the Taoist family, Zong Mojia, who had completely fallen into the arms of Yu Guo. The pressure they brought brought great pressure to Tian Guang in front of him.

Tian Guang was extremely terrified in his heart. From the bottom of his heart, he didn't want to take refuge in the so-called Yu Kingdom. There was only one person he really wanted to be loyal to, and that was the current second chancellor of Qin, Lord Changping.

Today's Lord Changping, seeing that the state of Qin is on the verge of collapse and its power has completely withdrawn to Hangu Pass, has long since moved back to the state of Chu to help his motherland become stronger and stronger.

And as the implementation of this idea, the peasant family of the world's first-rate school is an excellent weapon.

Not to mention, Mr. Changping's long-term connections in the Chu State have long been deeply rooted, and have penetrated into the court of Chu State, large and small.

Now that everything is ready, only when the war is completely over and all variables are eliminated, Lord Changping can return to Chu State with peace of mind and start a magnificent change.

And according to the information obtained by Tian Guang, the return to Chu State this time is not just about reform, it is very likely that a coup will be launched, and Lord Changping will succeed as the king of Chu State.

As the number one dark force of the future King Chu's subordinates, the future of the farm family is naturally limitless. The hope of restoring the previous grand occasion and even further progress is placed in front of Tian Guang.

With such a broad road, it is really difficult for Tian Guang to abandon his old master and turn to the Yu Kingdom in front of him.

As for the long speech that Zhong Yu just said, Tian Guang is extremely disdainful, and just regards it as a sophistry, a plaything of strategists and famous scholars.

After all, in this era, after the appearance of people like Zhang Yi and Su Qin, there has long been no shortage of sophists. They can often put forward a lot of truths, making people seem to be very correct, but in fact they are not practical and just empty talk.

The eloquence of these people has harmed many people and many countries. King Huai before Chu State is a living example.

It is a pity that the majestic king of a country, as the king of Chu who is on par with Qin, ended up in the situation of dying of old age in Qin.

So for this set of rhetoric, Tian Guang admits in his heart that he does have some truth, but he has a hehe attitude towards its practicality.

So Tian Guang struggled in his heart for a while, he didn't know how much he thought about it, and the expression on his face also changed, but in the end they all slowly turned into the same heart.

"His Royal Highness Prince Jing, please forgive Tian Guang for not agreeing. My farm family is a power in the rivers and lakes, with a hundred schools of thought, and I have no intention of relying on one country and one family. Moreover, the farm family's sphere of influence is in Chu State, which is more than thousands of miles away from Yu Kingdom. There is an unknown distance between them." How many countries are really hard to serve!" Tian Guang gritted his teeth and said what he was thinking.

He also put his mind to one side and ignored it.

Tian Guang was betting that the Prince Jing in front of him would not dare to kill him casually, and that the peasant family behind him would arouse the fear of the people in front of him and make him worry.

Tian Guang is even more betting that Lord Changping behind him, and the countries of Chu and Qin represented by Lord Changping, can scare the people in front of him.

After all, the current state of Chu is a very important force in the alliance. He represents 1/3 of the strength of the alliance, and he is also the maintainer of the entire southern battlefield. If Zhong Yu really doesn't care about it and insists on attacking Tian Guang, it is very likely to anger Chang Pingjun and cause changes in the battle situation on the southern front.

It was because of these reliance that Tian Guang dared to refuse.

However, contrary to his expectations, and even Master Ban and Xiaoyaozi's expectations, Prince Jing in front of him, that is, Zhong Yu, did not feel angry because of Tian Guang's refusal, and the expression on his face did not change even the slightest. The same calm, the same ancient well without waves.

"Well, since your Excellency doesn't want to join Yuguo, this king will naturally not force it. You can go and stay as you like, and no one will stop you!" As if chatting about family matters, the question just now was just casual and ordinary, and it is not easy to be declined. It's okay, just change the subject.

Such an attitude of not caring, on the contrary, made Tian Guang a little bit up and down, feeling like he couldn't get up and down.

This kind of punch seems to be condensed, but it hits the air. All the efforts are useless, and everything is just thinking about it. This kind of helplessness and frustration really makes people feel tired and angry.

Could it be that he and the farm family behind him are just so despised by the people in front of him? Even the slightest expression, the slightest fluctuation in tone, I can't bear to give it. Is my farm's weight so light?

When there is no more worry about life, Tian Guang's first thought is this instead.

I have to say that people are really cheap at certain times.

"Your Highness, Your Highness really doesn't blame Tian Guang? Blame me for brushing His Highness's face, blame me for not knowing what is good?" Tian Guang's tone was somewhat doubtful and expectant.

His question this time is to confirm once again whether he and the farm family are really safe? Can get out of the body. I want to try again, is my farm really insignificant in the heart of the person in front of me?

"What this king says is like water poured out. Naturally, it is impossible to take it back. You don't need to worry too much. I have no ill intentions towards you. This time, the solicitation is just out of the mentality of trying." The corner of the mouth showed With a slight smile, Zhong Yu looked at Tian Guang with some playfulness in his eyes, as if he saw a clown performing in front of him.

"Ah, oh! Your Highness is magnanimous, and Tian Guang admires him very much. Today's kindness will be engraved in his heart, and he will not dare to forget it!" Tian Guang was a little worried about gains and losses, and he was still underestimated.

However, he did not forget the business, raised his hands, cupped his fists and thanked Zhong Yu in front of him.

Let me do a survey to see how many people read this book. Gods who saw this epilogue, leave your footprints! I want the first floor.
